reviewer_role: backup_intake; independent reader, not implementation author
scope: Two new Python modules, original Model.jac/geometry/rates, inherited one-sided source masks and bounded callbacks; corresponding changed tests and Rust packed boundary read for consistency.
confirmed: Packed gas[n,4] and photon[12,K] map to original gas rows, photon diagonal, and ledgers2..7/10; zero pruning and row/column ordering match the original LIL-to-CSR structure.
Gas finite-difference step, admissibility direction flip, five RHS evaluations, thermal np.dot, and three-component photon loss summation retain the original operation paths.
Geometry and sigma caches use exact t.hex, interval epoch, q, and grid object identity; all set_interval calls invalidate before and after the parent one-sided-mask update.
Caches are disabled during original source-table construction; no native owner point-evaluation result is cached.
Packed payload owns contiguous copies and rejects wrong shape or nonfinite coefficients; native side rejects partial/unwritten or nonfinite preparation payload.
Physical and scaled callbacks reuse bounded represented-time rules and retain all19 ledgers and the original tolerances.
ABI2 callback signatures and pointer lengths agree with Rust; Python callback exceptions are contained, first failure is preserved, and failed or malformed-telemetry endpoints are rejected.
Bridge checks library digest and exact five bridge-source path digests before loading, then requires ABI2.
Successful Rust-packed admission verifies requested thread count, packed mode, zero foreign JVP calls, and per-segment preparation count equality; deltas are distinct from lifetime counters.

nonblocking_scope_notes.note: Cache correctness assumes the advertised fixed model during a solve. Direct replacement/mutation of private _clock, t_end, or masks is not part of the supported contract; no such mutation exists in the reviewed solve path.

The python_csr branch calls the verified legacy function directly, but its acceptance predicate does not additionally assert telemetry jvp_mode=legacy-foreign-per-vector and threads=1. No wrong-mode execution path was found; adding these assertions would only tighten comparison provenance.

The Python model regression class uses a manufactured owner and tabulate=False; wrapper smoke covers an analytical case. These changed-path checks do not establish actual tabulated HE29 transport or any of the four Radau/DOP853 reference results.

limitations: Static review only; existing recorded test outputs were not reproduced.
No claim of end-to-end native speedup, new physical validity, or continuous-spectrum error bound.
